name: ct-vuetify-soft-ui-dashboard-pro
description: Vuetify Soft UI Dashboard PRO is a beautiful resource built over Vuetify, Vuex and Vuejs 2

paragraphs: Vuetify Soft UI Dashboard PRO is a beautiful resource built over Vuetify, Vuex and Vuejs. It will help you get started developing dashboards in no time. Vuetify Soft UI Dashboard PRO is the official Vuejs version of the Original Soft UI Dashboard PRO. Using the Dashboard is pretty simple but requires basic knowledge of Javascript, Vuejs and Vue-Router.

We have created it thinking about things you actually need in a dashboard. Vuetify Soft UI Dashboard PRO contains handpicked and optimized Vuejs plugins. Everything is designed to fit with one another. As you will be able to see, the dashboard you can access on Creative Tim is a customization of this product.

Vuetify is developed exactly according to Material Design spec. Every component is handcrafted to bring you the best possible UI tools to your next great app. The development doesn't stop at the core components outlined in Google's spec. Through the support of community members and sponsors, additional components will be designed and made available for everyone to enjoy.
